label: Capacity of a nature: the nature n admits the perfection d
term: capacity of a nature to admit a perfection
definition: `CapacityFrame.Admits n d`, explicitly primitive: the nature n admits the perfection d, the 'capacitas naturae recipientis' of De ente cap.4. Distinguishing conditions: it is a relation between contents, not a reception of esse; both the reception account and the essence-only account of finitude use it. No structural property is assumed.
note: Stipulative analyst definition, attribution deferred; navigated from ST I q.4 a.1 ad 3, q.3 a.4 co. and De ente capp.3-4 (Baur/Koch), read in the materialized witnesses (docs/notes/rdep-to-ract.md).
